stock.description: Sun Art Retail Group Limited functions as an investment holding company, managing retail operations throughout the People's Republic of China through both traditional brick-and-mortar outlets and digital sales channels. Its diverse portfolio of retail establishments includes hypermarkets, superstores, and smaller mini stores, which operate under the RT-Mart, RT-Super, and RT-Mini brand names. As of March 31, 2022, the group's physical network comprised 490 hypermarkets, 9 superstores, and 103 mini stores. Beyond its primary retail focus, the company also offers consulting, investment management, wholesale distribution, and other retail-related services. Sun Art Retail Group Limited was established in 1998 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
